# Firecrawl QA

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — QA-test a live website with the Firecrawl browser and return a unified QA report: exploratory QA, form testing, navigation and link checks, responsive checks, performance observations, and pre-launch quality reviews. Uses Firecrawl map to discover pages, the Firecrawl browser for interactions, forms, navigation and responsive/manual checks, and scrape for page content and link extraction — parallelized across sub-agents when appropriate (navigation/links, forms/interactions, content/visual, error states). Distinct from the four published firecrawl-build-* listings: those cover API integration; this is a business workflow for testing websites. Requires a Firecrawl API key — Firecrawl is a hosted, likely paid service. By @firecrawl, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: quality of the report depends on the site's complexity and any auth walls; the skill starts with an onboarding interview (URL, focus, credentials) when context is missing. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
